NCIAC Secretariat. The NCIAC shall have a Secretariat to be
composed of officials from the member-agencies of the Committee. The Committee
shall provide for the guidelines for the creation of the Secretariat, including the
appropriate ranks of officials that shall comprise it.
2

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the remaining provisions not affected thereby shall continue to be in
full force and effect.

Repeal. Pursuant to RA No. 10844, Sections 3, 4 and 5 of EO No.
189 are hereby repealed. Further, except to the extent modified by this Order, all
other provisions of EO No. 189 shall remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 15 tday of
our Lord, Two Thousand and Nineteen.
